line: A flock of flamingos moves on every beat, and one young bird is always half a beat late; the ripples the others left on the water teach it the beat.
line_cn: 一群踩着拍子的火烈鸟里，只有一只小火烈鸟总慢半拍；鸟群留在水面上的涟漪，教会了它拍子。

camera.move: Telephoto, sun filling half the frame
camera.expresses: intimacy, a single gesture at its clearest
camera.serves: an introduction; a decision; a held breath

camera.move: Low lateral track at water level
camera.expresses: a group moving together, legs and splashes
camera.serves: a march; a chase; a procession
a cascade; a departure; a relay
"meanwhile"; a reveal of who was left behind
aftermath; loneliness; a pause with no beat
a count-in; a ritual; a joke landing

camera.expresses: the moment that matters, seen from around it
camera.serves: a climax; a record; a memory

transitions: Transitions belong to the medium: a near silhouette walking across the lens (a black wipe), a match cut on the same pose, a whip pan, a cut straight into a freeze.
labels: Roles: a heavy condensed sans for the title (120–150 px, e.g. Anton), a condensed sans for small lines (30–40 px, e.g. Barlow Condensed), a bold CJK sans for Chinese (≥ 34 px, e.g. Noto Sans SC). OFL, self-hosted, subset to the characters used.
Cream on the dark lower water, left-aligned in the lower third, never inside the sun, never centred, no shadow or stroke.
Type lands on the beat: one word per beat, each landing with a small ripple on the water under it. One word may land late or early on purpose.
Subtitles, when the film speaks: one line per language on the water at the bottom left, the same cream, clear of the figures; hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
motion: 30 fps, everything on ones. Poses snap into place in ~0.13 s with a small overshoot (ease-out-back) and hold until the next beat.
Feet stay planted in the world while walking or running (two-bone IK); never slide a standing figure.
Wings, steps and head turns are scheduled on the beat grid: the top of a wingbeat, a footfall, a head flag on the beat; double-time subdivision for running.
The freeze stops subject time and the shader's noise time together; only the sky phase and the sun height continue. A camera may move inside a frozen moment.

native_moves.name: The beat in unison
native_moves.does: A row or a flock changes pose on the same beat; one member doesn't.
native_moves.fits: a team where one player finds their timing; a choir; a production line with one machine out of step.

native_moves.name: The cascade
native_moves.does: The same action passes along a line, one figure per beat or half beat (take-off, a jump, a bow).
native_moves.fits: a relay; a domino of decisions; a crowd standing up for an anthem.

native_moves.name: The beat written on the water
native_moves.does: Footfalls leave ripples evenly spaced in time and space; they light up one per beat.
native_moves.fits: a trail to follow; a training plan; a song's rhythm shown as a path.

native_moves.name: The freeze with the sky still moving
native_moves.does: Everything stops on the hit, droplets in the air, while the colour keeps sinking; the camera may orbit.
native_moves.fits: a record jump; a goal; a wedding kiss; the last note of a show.

native_moves.name: The comic freeze
native_moves.does: The same device on a fall or a mistake, with a record stop.
native_moves.fits: a blooper; a failed first attempt; a punchline.

native_moves.name: The line across the sun
native_moves.does: A row of figures crosses the disc, doubled by its reflection.
native_moves.fits: a caravan; a migration; a team walking out.

native_moves.name: The black wipe
native_moves.does: A near figure crosses the lens and becomes the cut.
native_moves.fits: a change of place; a jump in time; a reveal.

score.note: tuned wood and metal percussion, plucked bass, a dry kit
